content: Xoossa Keeththan Go7ettiza Miishshata
Hessafe guye Solomooney adussateththay 20 wadha, gomppay 20 wadha, geesay 10 wadha gidiza yarsho yarshizaso xarqimalappe oosisides.
Qasse xarqimala seerisidi gomppay ya gaxappe ha gaxa gakkanaas 10 wadha, geesay 5 wadhanne yuuyi aadhdhanaas 30 wadha gidiza gita gabate medhissides.
Gita gabate doonan kare baggara ziqqi giidi izara oyketti medhettida misleti deettes; he misleti nam7u maaran de7iza boorata misleta.

He gita gabatey xarqimalappe medhettida boora misle tammanne nam7ata zokkon uttides. Booratappe heedzdzati pudeha bagga, heedzdzati arshey wulliza bagga, heedzdzati dugeha bagga, heedzdzati qasse arshey mokkiza bagga simmi xeelliza misateettes. Gita gabatey istta bolla uttides; istti ubbay issoy issaas duca zaari woththida.
Gita gabatezi issi tadhdhako keena orde; iza doonay picca; qasse ciishshi ciiyida misatees. He gita gabatezi 60,000 litiro gidiza haath oykkees.

Solomooney qasseka isttan meecettiza 10 Saaneta oosisides; histtidi 5 dugeha baggara, qasse 5 pudeha baggara woththides. Isttan xuugettiza yarsho ashoy meecettees; gido attiin gita gabateza haaththan qeeseti meecceettes.
Hessafe guye Solomooney isttas imettida halchcho mala xomppe woththiza 10 ballata worqqafe oosisidi, 5 pudeha baggara, 5 dugeha baggara Xoossa Keeththaa giddon woththides.
Qasseka izi 10 xaraphpheezata oosisidi 5 pudeha baggara, 5 dugeha baggara Xoossa Keeththaa giddon woththides; 100 xaarotakka worqqafe medhissides.
Solomooney qeesetas giddo zagonne kare baggan gita zago giigsides; zagozas pengeta giigsidi pengeta xarqimalan meeshides.
Gita gabateza Xoossa Keeththafe dugeha baggara arshey mokkiza baggan woththides.
Huraam-Abey kereta, qaphetanne xaarota medhdhides; histtidi Huraam-Abey Kawo Solomoones Xoossaa keeththan go7ettiza miishshata ooso polides.
Izi ooththida miishshatikka nam7u tuussata, tuussata xeeran woththiza saane mala nam7u qustteta, tuussata bolla de7iza nam7u qustteta alleqissiza nam7u gite mala sansalatata,
issi issi qustte bolla nam7u maaran xarqimalappe medhettida issi issi xeet oroomaane teera misleta, mulera 400 oroomaane teera misleta,
isttan miishshata woththiza 10 gaareta, 10 meechcha gabateta,
Gita gabatezanne izappe garsan de7iza 12 boorata misleta,
kereta, qapheta, xaarotanne hara miishshata ubbaa. Huraam-Abey Kawo Solomoones Xoossa Keeththa oosos medhdhida ha miishshata ubbaa qucettida xarqimalappe medhdhides.
Kawo Solomooney Sukooteppenne Xaaredeppe giddon Yordaanoose zullen de7iza xarqimala seerisiza sohon haytantta ubbaa oosisides.
Xarqimalappe medhettida ha miishshati ubbay keehi daro gidida gishshas ay keena deexxizaakko erettibeenna.
Qasseka Solomooney Xoossaa keeththan de7iza miishshata ubbaa worqqafe medhissides; heytikka worqqafe oosettida yarsho yarshizaso, Xoossaa sinththan woththiza ukeththi iza bolla uttiza xaraphpheeza,
isttas imettida wogaa mala Ubbaafe Aadhdhiza Giddo qol7aa sinththan poo7ana mala xomppe woththiza worqqa ballata, istta worqqa xomppeta,
muuruta worqqafe oosettida ciishsha misleta, xomppetanne qapheta,

xomppeza toyssiza miishshata, xaarota, exaane cuwasiza miishshatanne tama ekkiza miishshata. Ha miishshati ubbay muuruta worqqafe oosettida. Xoossa keeththaas kare bagga pengetanne Ubbaafe Dummatiza Giddo Qol7a geliza pengeta worqqan meeshides.
